title: Model WordPress topology as durable nouns
context: The phase-per-node board turned each correlated action into a horizontal card row, duplicated the same WordPress object on revisits, and made connection open and close events occupy spatial identity. This contradicted AgentTrail's stable component map and made replay a log wearing a graph costume.
decision: Resolve declared and observed events onto stable entity keys such as wp:post:464 and wp:option:blogdescription. Reuse those nodes for every visit, render presence lifecycle as reusable channel-edge state, append evidence and property history inside the entity, and assign positions once in first-touch order from the top-left. Journey phases remain audit evidence and time controls animate state over the stable map.
consequences: The trail and correlation reducer remain intact while the board projection and layout are replaced. Repeated actions become counts and history on one node, bare connector activity creates no node, replay preserves spatial memory, and clustering can later compact entity groups without changing identity.
